'''2017 MPC Matt Scott DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Scott]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Scott]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
